images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new wide 16:9 narrative illustration for a Korean fantasy lorebook. The supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their ancient weathered East Asian mural appearance extremely closely: ochre plaster, mineral pigments, charcoal black brush silhouettes, restrained vermilion accents, flaked paint and irregular hairline cracks integrated through the scene, flat painterly depth with intricately painted architecture. No photorealistic CGI, glossy lighting, neon magic, modern objects, lettering, labels or borders. Full-bleed rectangular artwork. Preserve legibility at 830px wide. Scene: Cheonjugung, the vast subterranean palace beneath the imperial capital. A solemn oblique view into immense shadowed stone halls with tiers of ancient pillars, descending stairs and ceremonial gates. The deepest distant throne has no visible occupant; its presence is conveyed through stillness and architecture, not a glowing ghost. One small armored gate guardian stands motionless before the innermost entrance, dwarfed by the palace. Faint dark-red vein-like lines are carved into the worn stone paving. Oppressive sacred quiet, very sparse figures, grand monumental scale. Do not depict a battle or the emperor catching an arrow.

The theme is military organization containing an individual master, not a duel and not an actual dragon. Avoid fantasy glowing circles or laser beams. Readable broad geometry, landscape war-mural composition.
